LanguageData.Skylight_NoRoof: No roof above — open sky already lights this spot
LanguageData.Skylight_ThickRoof: Blocked by overhead mountain — no daylight gets through solid rock
LanguageData.Skylight_NeedsSupport: Must be within {0} tiles of a wall or pillar to hold up the roof
LanguageData.Skylights_DomeRadiusDesc: How far the soft light from dome and mountain-dome skylights spreads. Takes effect immediately.
LanguageData.Skylights_RoofEdge_SkylightsOnly: Skylights only — soft edge inward around skylights (experimental)
LanguageData.Skylights_RoofEdge_Full: All roofs — soft edge inward at every roof edge (experimental)
LanguageData.Skylights_RoofEdgeModeDesc: ⚠ Under development. The idea: keep the tiles just outside a roof fully lit and soften the shadow edge inward instead, so light appears to reach just past a skylight. The inward modes currently have rendering bugs — dome skylights may not glow, and a bright artifact can appear near walls where the shadow should be darkest. Leave this on Vanilla for now; the inward modes are here for testing only.
LanguageData.Skylights_Display_Selectable: Selectable — sprites drawn and skylights are directly clickable (circle)
LanguageData.Skylights_Display_Visible: Visible — sprites drawn, clicks pass through to what's beneath (check)
LanguageData.Skylights_Display_Hidden: Hidden — no sprites; skylights keep working invisibly (X)
LanguageData.Skylights_HUD_Selectable: Skylights: selectable\n\nSprites are drawn and skylights can be clicked directly for their inspect pane. Click to cycle: selectable → visible → hidden.
LanguageData.Skylights_HUD_Visible: Skylights: visible\n\nSprites are drawn; clicks pass through to whatever is beneath. Click to cycle: visible → hidden → selectable.
LanguageData.Skylights_HUD_Hidden: Skylights: hidden\n\nSprites are hidden — skylights keep channeling daylight, growing crops and pooling their stained-glass light exactly the same. Click to cycle: hidden → selectable → visible.
LanguageData.Skylights_VisibilityCmdDesc: Cycle how installed skylights present themselves: selectable (sprites drawn, directly clickable — circle), visible (sprites drawn, clicks pass through — check), or hidden (no sprites — X). Whatever the mode, skylights keep channeling daylight and lighting the room exactly the same.
LanguageData.Skylights_OpacityCmdDesc: Adjust how strongly installed skylight glass and frames are drawn, from barely-there to fully visible. Currently {0}%. Applies to every installed skylight and takes effect immediately.
LanguageData.Skylights_VisibilityButtonDesc: Adds a button to the bottom-right overlay row that cycles the installed-skylight display mode above (selectable / visible / hidden) with one click, badged circle / check / X. Whatever the mode, skylights keep working. Turning this off removes the button.
LanguageData.Skylights_NotOnShip: Requires structurally supported ship glazing — ordinary skylight glass can't take a gravship's flight stresses. Build stained-glass windows here instead.
LanguageData.Skylights_OpacitySettingDesc: How strongly installed skylight glass and frames are drawn. Also adjustable from the Skylights architect tab. Takes effect immediately.
